content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IISER Pune Research Associate Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 09-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Pune (IISER Pune) for filling up research positions under a sponsored project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised under Advt No 78/2026?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Research Associate under IISER Pune Recruitment 2026, offering temporary employment opportunities for qualified candidates in the field of chemistry research.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Research Associate position in this recruitment drive issued by IISER Pune for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in Chemistry. Additional hands-on experience in Organic synthesis, Catalysis, and Flow chemistry will be given preference during shortlisting.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for applying to this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 35 years. Candidates must ensure they meet this age criterion before submitting their applications via email.

faq.question: Q6. What salary will be provided to the selected Research Associate?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 47,000/- along with a 30% House Rent Allowance as per institutional and funding agency norms.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed application form via email is 09-10-2026. Late submissions will not be entertained by the institute.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for IISER Pune Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent via email in the prescribed format converted into PDF format and addressed to the designated official email address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a review by a Screening Committee followed by an interview of shortlisted candidates conducted by IISER Pune.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website of IISER Pune?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website of the institute at www.iiserpune.ac.in to get detailed updates, notifications, and application formats regarding this job opening.
